title: NIST WebBook: Toluene is C7H8, molecular weight 92.1384 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Toluene as C7H8, molecular weight 92.1384 amu, CAS 108-88-3.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Toluene, CAS Registry Number 108-88-3, lists molecular formula C7H8 and molecular weight 92.1384 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 92.0626003 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C7H8/c1-7-5-3-2-4-6-7/h2-6H,1H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
